opening.argument: The offer pairs paid packages with tokens described as a right to mine for profit, and the package table displays euro prices alongside token quantities. The speaker also connects successive partner invitations to recurring commissions, with matching-bonus payments depending on the package purchased. Together, these claims present paid mining and recruitment-linked rewards as the route to financial returns. The speaker discusses tokens being purchased on an exchange and a potentially rising rate, but expressly says there are no guarantees and the records do not establish that any payment, mining, exchange listing, or reward was completed.

citations.quote: A token is a right to mine one coin to make a profit.
Also it is paid once a week, and also on Mondays, from one to four generations, depending on which package you entered
but there are no guarantees here, everything depends exclusively on the ratio of supply-purchase
